title: Customer Custom Fields — shared definitions
description: Reusable definitions for the Customer Custom Fields API (attributes on a customer, plus the field/group definitions behind them). Referenced by the per-endpoint request/response schemas.

ResponseEnvelope.description: Every endpoint returns HTTP 200 and carries this envelope. Success is response_code 'S200'. On any error response_code is an 'E###' code (or, for an unknown field id on write, a free-text string). ALWAYS branch on response_code, never on HTTP status. The only non-200 is a malformed/empty JSON body, which the JSON layer rejects as HTTP 500 before the application runs.

response_code.description: 'S200' on success; otherwise an error code (see the family README error table) or, on updateCustomerField with an unknown field, the free-text '<id> is Invalid, '.

response_ref_id.description: Opaque per-call trace id assigned by the service. Echo it in support tickets.

response_code_desc.description: Human-readable description of response_code. Empty string for several error codes that have no description row.

ErrorResponse.description: Shape of an error reply: the envelope with a non-'S200' response_code and payload fields blank/null. Returned with HTTP 200.

CustomerIdentifier.description: Identifies the customer. Supply exactly ONE of the four keys. Keys are camelCase.

partyId.description: Internal customer id. Fastest path; no lookup.

externalId.description: An external id (e.g. a POS or loyalty id) resolved via the customer's identification records using the deployment's default identifier type. Unmatched -> E145.

phone.description: Phone number; dashes are stripped. Fewer than 10 digits -> E1039.

GroupType.description: Kind of attribute group. CUSTOM_FIELD: a field holds a value. SEGMENTATION: membership IS the value — the returned field ids are the segments the customer belongs to. ECONOMIC_METRIC: numeric metrics. Any other value -> E153.

FieldFormat.description: Presentation/format of a field value (the CF_FLD_FORMAT vocabulary). A value outside this list -> E1004.

CustomFieldValue.description: One stored attribute value on a customer, as returned by the read endpoints.

customFieldId.description: Field identifier. For a SEGMENTATION group this is the segment membership itself.

FieldDefinition.description: A field definition as returned when listing a group's fields.

isEnabled.description: Enabled flag; often returned as an empty string.

customFieldLength.description: Declared maximum length, as a string.

GroupObject.description: A group with its fields and (for the per-entity read endpoints) each field's stored value for the requested customer. 'group' is null when the entity has no stored value for the group.

field_value.description: The customer's stored value for this field; null when unset.

param_data.description: Option metadata for the field, when defined; otherwise null.
